title: Bilingual (English + Gujarati) copy across landing page

requirements.summary: Add Gujarati alongside existing English copy across all landing page sections while preserving structure, CTAs, and contact links.
acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation labels and brand tagline include Gujarati alongside English (e.g., English text plus Gujarati in parentheses or on a second line) without breaking the layout on mobile or desktop.
Hero headline, subheadline, and CTA button labels include Gujarati alongside English, and the existing links remain exactly: tel:+918000262644 and https://wa.me/918000262644.
Services section title/description and each service card title/description/price text include Gujarati alongside English (keeping service list and pricing semantics intact).
Areas Served section heading and supporting text include Gujarati alongside English; the area names may remain in English if desired, but any explanatory sentences include Gujarati alongside English.
Footer headings, quick links, contact/booking labels, and descriptive paragraph include Gujarati alongside English; do not remove the existing business name and attribution line.
No user-facing text becomes Gujarati-only; English remains present everywhere user-facing text exists.

file_operations.description: Update brand tagline and header navigation/CTA labels to include Gujarati alongside existing English (e.g., second line or parentheses) while keeping the same header structure and ensuring the contact links remain unchanged (tel:+918000262644 and https://wa.me/918000262644).

Update hero headline, subheadline, and CTA button labels to mixed English + Gujarati copy while keeping the same layout, background asset usage, and ensuring CTA href values remain exactly tel:+918000262644 and https://wa.me/918000262644.

Update services section heading/description and each service card’s title/description/price strings to include Gujarati alongside English, preserving the existing service list, pricing semantics, and component structure (do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui).
Update Areas Served heading and supporting sentences to include Gujarati alongside English (area names may remain English), and keep the existing phone link destination unchanged (tel:+918000262644).

Update footer headings, quick links labels, contact/booking labels, and descriptive paragraph to include Gujarati alongside English, while preserving existing business name and attribution line and keeping CTA href values unchanged (tel:+918000262644 and https://wa.me/918000262644).

Apply minor global typography/spacing adjustments (e.g., line-height/text wrapping helpers or font fallbacks that support Gujarati) to accommodate bilingual text without changing the overall visual theme.
